name: Rhymes
description: Fun nursery rhymes and CBSE Marigold Class 1 poems!

items.lines:

items.speakText: If you're happy and you know it clap your hands

items.lines:

items.lines:

items.speakText: After a bath I try try try to wipe myself dry dry dry

items.speakText: White and fluffy in the sky clouds go drifting one by one

items.lines:

items.lines:

items.speakText: One little kitten playing in the sun two little kittens look how they run

items.lines:

items.speakText: A man in the flying machine waved his hands to me below
